text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their 
skills began once again this year. As for 
Gentildonna—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To think there was a place like this near 
the training lodge.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, take a look. They have swimwear too.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful streamline... very practical. 
The frill design is understated as well, 
quite elegant.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: Wanna take a quick peek inside?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Dressing you up might actually be quite 
fun too.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...What's with that meaningful look on 
your face?"
choice_data_list:
I had no idea you liked it so much you 
wanted to dress me up in it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That's right. So... you will follow my 
lead, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It might take time, but a little detour 
shouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The future where you become stronger will 
never change."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—This year as well, the passionate summer 
training camp begins!
